╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

Three months ago, Sigma-7 Research Station went dark.

No distress calls. No automated reports. Nothing but silence from the
orbital facility that housed humanity's most classified research
programmes.

You were sent to investigate.

You don't remember the crash. You don't remember how you ended up in
the emergency airlock. But you remember your mission: find out what
happened, and get out alive.

The escape pod is offline. The station AI watches your every move.
And something in the shadows doesn't want you to leave.

Welcome to Sigma-7. Good luck.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  TIPS: Type 'help' for commands. For items, use key words
  (e.g., 'take crowbar' not 'take heavy crowbar').
  Stuck? Check the hints/ folder for guidance.
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ▸ MAIN CORRIDOR
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
The central hub of Sigma-7 stretches before you—a wide passage with damaged
ceiling panels and exposed conduits sparking intermittently. Emergency
lighting casts long shadows. Doors branch off in multiple directions:
storage to the south, the research lab to the east (security locked),
engineering to the west, and crew quarters further north. A small
maintenance drone hovers near the ceiling, its optical sensor tracking your
movements.

A small maintenance drone hovers near the ceiling, its optical sensor focusing on you. Unlike the hostile units, this one's shell is marked with faded yellow paint—a service bot, not security. It chirps questioningly.

Exits: south, east (locked), west, north

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  ▸ ENGINEERING BAY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
The heart of the station's power systems. The massive engine core dominates
the chamber, its surface scarred with impact damage. Warning klaxons would
be blaring if the speakers still worked. Sparking conduits snake across the
floor like dying serpents. Control panels display cascading errors in
languages you don't recognise. Something moved in the shadows near the
auxiliary systems—something mechanical.
